Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vinod - 36 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Meenakshi - 25 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Shalini - 64 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Manoj - 61 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
5. Vikram - 29 years, friend
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Vinod stands on the road. Shalini and Manoj stand near him.]

Manoj: "What lovely weather!"

[Vinod's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Vinod (laughing): "Careful!"

[Vinod's car crashes into a pole.]

Vinod: "Dad, look at this."

[A dog runs in front of Vinod's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Vinod: "Okay, Dad."

[Vinod loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Shalini: "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The kitchen - Day

Shalini: "So, here we are!"

[Meenakshi rolls out rotis on the board.]

Vikram: "Let's see."

[Meenakshi stirs the dal in the pot.]

Vinod: "That's easy."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Manoj: "So, here we are!"

[Vinod pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Vinod: "Careful!"

[Vinod sips red wine.]

Manoj: "That was fun!"

[Vinod drinks a beer.]

Vinod (excited): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Vinod staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Shalini: "Manoj, are you okay?"

[Vinod and Mother clink their glasses.]

Shalini: "Yes, of course."

Scene 4: The road - Day

[Vinod stands by the road. Shalini, Manoj and Meenakshi stand near him.]

Shalini: "Let's begin."

[Vinod rides his motorbike to the market.]

Shalini: "Exactly right."

[Vinod drives the car to the office.]

Vinod (happily): "Show me too!"

[Vinod gets out of the car.]

Meenakshi: "I really enjoyed today."
